correctness.rationale: For 0<|epsilon|<=1/4 the support curvature tensor I+epsilon(∇²_S P+P I) is positive by the explicit Hessian norm and cubic bound, with width two by oddness. Published exact directional area b=pi-(pi epsilon²/4) product(1-n_i²) gives normalized Y=product(1-U_i²), independent of epsilon. Haar spherical coordinates S=|Z| uniform[0,1], Phi uniform imply Y=A(S)+B(S) sin²(2Phi) with A=s²(1-s²) and B=(1-s²)³/4; arcsine conditioning yields claimed entire CDF and differentiated density. The maximum T(s)=A+B occurs at s=1/sqrt(3), giving support [0,8/27]. On the sphere there are 6 quadratic minima, 8 diagonal maxima, and 12 nondegenerate saddles at 1/4 with local form 1/4+w²/4-alpha²; the coarea delta integral contributes 1/(2pi) log(1/|y-1/4|) per saddle, hence 6/pi total. Cap-area expansions yield endpoint slopes 3/2 and 9/2. Independent exact Dirichlet moments give 4/21,128/3003 and variance400/63063. Numerical checks are secondary, not the all-directions proof.
